description: The bottom dock starts with the default floating gap, moves flush to the screen edge when Floating is disabled, and then returns to the gap.

assertions.comment: Before I disable Floating, I see the default 108px-high surface that includes room for the bottom gap.
Before I disable Floating, I see the panel start at y=36.
Before I disable Floating, I see the 64px panel end at y=100, leaving 8px below it in the 108px surface.
After I disable Floating, I see the surface shrink to 100px so the panel can meet the screen edge.
After I disable Floating, I see the flush panel start at y=36.
After I disable Floating, I see the 64px panel end exactly at y=100 with no gap below it.
When I turn Floating back on, I see the 108px-high surface and its gap return.
